summary: Frontend-only testing of PiezoLab 3D CAD simulator. All 5 tabs (Baldosa, Viga, CAD, Materiales, Reporte) render correctly via hash routing with full page reload. 3D viewer (Three.js) draws stack/springs/plates for tile and cantilever+tip mass for beam. All required data-testids are present. Physics values match expectations: baldosa V_oc=55.4 V, C_p=47.3 nF; viga f1=72.6 Hz, R_opt=60.6 kΩ, P_max WY=269 µW. Sliders (tile-fmax, beam-tipmass) update results in live: Voc 55.4→79.1 V, f1 72.6→34.6 Hz. View mode buttons (perspective/orthographic/section/wireframe) work without errors. tile-compare & tile-compare-clear buttons work. Beam mode 1/2/3 buttons present and clickable. CAD editor toggles Baldosa/Viga viewer correctly; all 3 exports (STL, CSV, JSON) trigger downloads with correct filenames (baldosa.stl, baldosa_series_temporal.csv, baldosa_resumen.json). Materials table fully editable with localStorage persistence verified (edited d33 PZT-5A to 999, persisted after reload). Report tab renders Chart.js charts (report-chart-tile, report-chart-beam) and print button. Formula tooltips (data-testid=formula-info) present and hoverable.

integration_issues.issue: App reads hash only via useState initializer (initialTab) with no window 'hashchange' listener. Changing location.hash without a full page reload does NOT switch tabs. Playwright page.goto to same URL differing only in hash does not reload, so hash-only navigation from an already-loaded page can silently fail. Tab button onClick works fine; hash reload (with a query param change forcing reload) also works. Recommend adding a hashchange listener in App.tsx to keep behavior consistent with the agent-to-agent note claiming hash navigation is reliable.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add window.addEventListener('hashchange', ...) in App.tsx to sync tab state when only the hash changes without a reload, so external URL-hash navigation is truly reliable (agent-to-agent note claimed this).
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx: hash routing uses only initial state, no hashchange listener — deep-linking works only on hard reload.

Physics sanity: V_oc for a stack in mode-33 is independent of N (Q=n·d33·F and C_p=n·ε₀εrA/t cancel n). Slider tile-nlayers correctly leaves V_oc unchanged; ensure documentation/tooltip clarifies this so it's not perceived as a bug. Q, E, energy-vs-N chart do respond as expected.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared localStorage 'piezolab.materials.v1' during testing to reset defaults after editing d33.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use full page reload (e.g. append a ?r=N query param before the #hash) when navigating between tabs via URL, because App.tsx does not listen to hashchange events. To programmatically move React-controlled range inputs, use the native input value setter workaround: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el, value) then dispatch input+change events, otherwise React ignores the value change. Confirmed physics targets: baldosa Voc≈55.4V, Cp≈47.3nF; viga f1≈72.6Hz, Ropt≈60.6kΩ, Pmax_WY≈269µW.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. The only functional gap is that App.tsx doesn't subscribe to hashchange; this is a minor UX/testing issue, not a runtime failure.
